question: Do the completed full-run critics rank the existing first-boss and Act2-card alternatives better than the parent, separately or when both recorded choices are changed?
limits: Exploratory read-only diagnosis, not a new deployed policy or acceptance. Every measured intervention holds all other choices to the original parent. Scores are restricted to the fully labelled candidate set; full-menu proposals outside that set are reported, not assigned imagined outcomes. Earlier deaths stay in the1536-family denominator. Each family uses its excluding-fold model. No native implementation of these scoped probes, new games, fits, threshold tuning, external holdout or adoption.
